text: Hey, just checking in on the PR — looks like the tests are passing now. I think we're good to merge.
So here's what I'm thinking: we should refactor the training loop to use the SFTTrainer instead of rolling our own. It handles the common patterns and we can focus on the LoRA config.

Alright, let me break this down. The issue is that when you quantize to 4-bit, the weights lose precision. But LoRA works around this because we're only training the small adapter matrices in full precision.
Quick note on the 5090 — with 32 GB VRAM we can comfortably fit a 7B model at 4-bit with room for a decent batch size. The bottleneck will be sequence length more than model size.
I went ahead and set up the worktree with the setup-worktree script. Remember to run that after creating a new worktree or you'll hit the MissingEntrypointError with Vite.
